dataset: A public dataset of overground and treadmill walking kinematics (WBDS)
authors: Fukuchi CA, Fukuchi RK, Duarte M
record_used: 42 subjects x 8 treadmill speeds; RKneeAngleZ over the gait cycle (328 curves)
note: Treadmill speed is the ordinal trial index T01(slowest)..T08(fastest); the WBDS per-subject speeds are a dimensionless sweep, so speed is modelled as an ordinal level, not m/s.
